high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a Wikipedia page about Franklin D. Roosevelt, the 32nd President of the United States. The page includes a portrait of Franklin D. Roosevelt, labeled as an "Official campaign portrait, 1944." The portrait shows him wearing a dark suit with a white shirt and a dark tie with small polka dots. Below the portrait, there is a section titled "32nd President of the United States," which provides information about his presidency. It states that he was "In office" from March 4, 1933, to April 12, 19
